dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single prominent white band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against dark flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and distinct pale white edges along the outer webs of folded secondary and primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly rectangular white patch of high contrast located on the posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, high-contrast linear boundary between the black crown and the grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white auricular patch visible on the lateral aspect of the head.
